landing_promise_intro: tattou.ink takes care of everything that pulls you away from your work.
landing_promise_outro: While you're focused on your client, {#b}everything else keeps moving forward{/b}.
landing_promise_kicker: Built with tattoo artists. For the real job, not an idealized version of it.
landing_benefit1_body: Confirmations, reminders and deposits shouldn't follow you home. Tattou.ink automates the steps that repeat themselves. You don't have to think about it anymore.
landing_benefit1_kicker_title: Every step of an appointment triggers the right action at the right time
landing_benefit1_kicker_line2: Your calendar stays clear. So does your head.
landing_benefit2_body_2: Your clients can choose, book and fill in their information. Meanwhile, you're already busy doing your job.
landing_benefit2_before_1: Posting your flashes one by one.
landing_benefit2_before_2: Answering the same questions for every client.
landing_benefit2_before_3: Manually removing a design that's already booked.
landing_benefit2_before_4: Chasing deposits by hand. It takes forever.
landing_benefit2_after_1: The flashbook stays organized and up to date.
landing_benefit2_after_2: The client chooses, books and pays on their own.
landing_benefit2_after_4: You get a complete file. Everything's ready.
landing_benefit2_caption_title: Your collections. Your tags. Filters. Your forms.
landing_benefit2_caption_body: As many collections as you need. Filters to quickly find a design. Configurable forms to collect exactly the information you need.
landing_benefit3_body: You don't have to remember everything. The important information stays attached to the right client, the right project and the right appointment. When you need it, it's all there.
landing_benefit3_highlight: You don't have to keep it all in your head anymore.
landing_testimony_title_line2: they talk about it better than we do.
landing_testimony_1_quote: Before, I had 2,456 messages waiting. Booking requests, questions, follow-ups… and always the feeling of being behind on something. Now, part of the work moves forward without me. Clients have the info, reminders go out, deposits are tracked. It's one less weight to carry.
landing_testimony_2_quote: My flashbook mostly lived on Instagram and in my head. Between messages, screenshots and bookings, it quickly became a mess. Now people can browse, choose and book without me being glued to my phone.
landing_testimony_3_quote: I thought it would just save me a bit of time. In reality, what I appreciate most is not having to think about everything anymore. When a client arrives, I already have the information I need.
landing_testimony_4_quote: I'm often busy drawing or tattooing, so I can't reply to every message right away. Before, I felt guilty leaving people without an answer. Now, a good part of the journey is already clear for them.
landing_app_body: One single app to track your appointments, your clients, your projects and everything that comes with them.
landing_app_feature_1_title: See your day at a glance.
landing_app_feature_1_body: Drag, move and organize your appointments. Confirmations and reminders follow automatically.
landing_app_feature_2_title: All your client's info in one place.
landing_app_feature_2_body: Name, address, pictures, sessions, payments. All of it.
landing_app_feature_3_body: Your flashbook online under 5 minutes. Set up filtering tags and optional prices and you're all set.
landing_app_feature_4_body: We collect and safely store their personal data. And if you need more, build forms your clients will fill out at checkout time.
landing_app_feature_5_body: Register payments from any source to make sure there is no awkward money talk during their session. Optional booking fee with Stripe.
landing_app_feature_6_body: No timezone headache. Your flashbook is available in 10+ languages. Charge a booking fee in the local currency.
landing_app_feature_7_body: No need to remember if they got in touch with you through email, DMs or Whatsapp. It's in the chat, just like that.
landing_app_feature_8_body: Your work is available at yourname.tattou.ink. No need to build a website, we take care of it.
landing_pricing_body: No surprises. No features hidden behind fifteen subscription tiers. One single price, all inclusive.
landing_pricing_features_intro: All features are included in both plans. The only difference:
landing_manifesto_title: A line is only drawn once.
landing_manifesto_body_1: Tattooing demands presence. Real presence. It calls for attention, patience, and respect for the person in the chair. Anything that fragments that focus takes something away from the work. Constant distraction has a cost, and it's paid in energy, care and quality.
landing_manifesto_body_2: Tattou.ink exists to protect that space. Less noise. More clarity. More room to do the work well...
wise_this_panther_race: Publish your flashbook, keep your clients organized, plan guests abroad, all in one app.

landing_android_dialog_body: Our Android app is almost ready, but we need to manually approve new testers before you can install it. Email us and we'll set you up, or start using the web app right away, no install needed.
